description: Experience wonderful Studio City living in this attractive condo, where modern design and effortless convenience converge. This two-bedroom, two-bath condominium offers a light-filled open floor plan with rich wood flooring, and an ambiance of understated elegance. The kitchen, outfitted with stainless steel appliances and polished granite countertops, flows seamlessly into the spacious living and dining areas—perfect for both entertaining and quiet evenings at home. The primary suite is a private sanctuary, featuring a custom walk-in closet and a spa-inspired bath complete with a glass-enclosed shower and a deep soaking tub. Curated details such as recessed lighting, plantation shutters, and a discreet in-unit washer and dryer enhance everyday comfort. Step outside to your expansive, enclosed patio—a serene retreat ideal for al fresco dining or morning reflection. Situated on a tranquil, tree-lined street with gated access, this condo offers both privacy and peace of mind. Enjoy low HOA fees while living moments from Ventura Boulevard’s acclaimed dining, boutique shopping, and the newly reimagined Sportsmen’s Lodge social center. With easy access to studios and major freeways, this residence embodies the sophistication and convenience of modern Studio City living. Features new HVAC, new windows, new water heater and a new updated electrical panel.
